newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sets product refunds for January 1.
newsitem.headline: EU sets product refunds for January 1.

text.p: The European Union's cereals management committee on Thursday fixed annual export refunds for processed products, compound feed and non-annex II products from January 1, an EU offcial said on Friday.
"The cereals and rice management committee set refunds for processed products for January because there will be no meeting before that date," the official said.
The committee set the following refunds:
durum wheat 7.59 ecus /t processed and non-annex II only
oats 29.22 ecus /t processed and non-annex 11 only
rye 33.09 ecus /t processed and non-annex II only
broken rice 33.06 ecus /t processed and non-annex II only
round rice 250.00 ecus /t processed and non-annex II only
long grain 250.00 ecus /t processed and non-annex II only
potato starch 45.09 ecus /t processed and non-annex II only
